thread:
anna-devsec: :rotating_light: seeing a spike of KMS Decrypt errors across prod-ap-svc at 02:14 UTC. Error ratio ~18% over 3m. Marking incident and starting warroom.
raj-oncall: on it. Do we have a quick blast radius? which SA/key?
anna-devsec: serviceAccount: infra-gc-prod-svc; key: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/main/cryptoKeys/ingest. Errors indicate 'PermissionDenied' and some 'ResourceExhausted' in the same window.
ben-sre: grabbing logs now, enabling debug on KMS client. ETA 2m.
secops-bot: Incident INC-2026-1123 created and paged oncall. Docs link: https://redwood.atlassian/INC-2026-1123
leila-eng: tagging storage and data pipelines; they might be the callers. Can we throttle traffic to the cluster?
matt-psf: scheduling a temporary deny-policy for infra-gc-prod-svc while we triage. Will coordinate with IAM.
raj-oncall: steps: (1) collect evidence, (2) contain (deny SA / rotate key), (3) fallback to secondary key if available, (4) restore traffic. Agreed?
anna-devsec: agreed. evidence collection: paste the relevant log tail here.
ben-sre: ```
2026-04-12T02:13:59Z ERROR kms.googleapis.com Decrypt PermissionDenied caller=infra-gc-prod-svc resource=projects/../cryptoKeys/ingest
2026-04-12T02:14:03Z ERROR kms.googleapis.com Decrypt ResourceExhausted caller=infra-gc-prod-svc
2026-04-12T02:14:10Z INFO compute.googleapis.com instance started id=instance-42
```
leila-eng: looks like a deployment coincided at 02:14. Could be a misconfigured SA in the new rollout. Rolling back the deploy now.
raj-oncall: rollback in progress. Confirm when rollback complete and link to deployment id.
leila-eng: rollback complete at 02:17 UTC. service traffic dropped ~40%.
matt-psf: IAM deny applied to infra-gc-prod-svc (temporary) at 02:18. Command: `gcloud iam service-accounts remove-iam-policy-binding infra-gc-prod-svc --member=serviceAccount:infra-gc-prod-svc@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter`
anna-devsec: good containment. We should rotate the ingest key and switch callers to a new key to avoid lateral exposure. Any downstream effects?
ben-sre: no other callers for that key in logs besides infra-gc-prod-svc. We'll prepare a new key and test in staging.
secops-bot: Evidence snapshot saved: gs://redwood-secops/incidents/INC-2026-1123/evidence-20260412-0219.tar.gz
raj-oncall: who is taking the next shift for post-incident follow-up? Need someone to own rotation, RBAC audit, and postmortem writeup.
leila-eng: I can own rotation + deploy verification. Will work with IAM.
matt-psf: I'll handle RBAC review and verify no overly broad bindings exist.
anna-devsec: assigning postmortem owner to anna-devsec for timeline + mitigation docs. Please add links to runbooks and remedial PRs.
ben-sre: quick note — found two retries from a job that should've backoffed; that contributed to ResourceExhausted. Adding rate-limits on the client side.
leila-eng: opened PR to pin SA in deployment: https://git.redwood/pr/8343 (will also add explicit KMS key env var).
raj-oncall: confirm we want to rotate key now or wait until PR merges? Rotating immediately will require updating callers.
anna-devsec: rotate after we validate fallback key in staging. Do not rotate until we have tested because caller is critical. For immediate safety we left the deny in place.
matt-psf: scheduling a key rotation plan: create new key, add decrypt permission to a temp maint SA, run smoke tests, then swap env var, then revoke old key. Timeline estimate 90m after approval.
secops-bot: Reminder: enable detailed audit logs for KMS and IAM for 30d as part of follow-up.
ben-sre: captured timeline snippet for postmortem: `02:13:59 first Decrypt errors; 02:14:04 deployment rollout started; 02:17:00 rollback complete; 02:18:30 deny binding applied; 02:19:20 evidence snapshot saved.`
leila-eng: adding remediation checklist to the incident ticket and pinging the release owner to coordinate a safer redeploy.
anna-devsec: next actions (short):
- leila: finish PR to pin SA + add KMS env var (in progress)
- matt: run RBAC audit and open any required least-privilege fixes
- ben: add client retry/backoff and follow-up integration test
- raj: schedule 1:1 with infra on-call to review deploy gating
- anna: write postmortem draft and coordinate with legal & compliance for any external reporting needs
raj-oncall: handing off incident to second shift. Oncall coverage: @raj-oncall until 04:00 UTC, then @maria-oncall. Handoff notes in ticket.
leila-eng: quick Q — do we need to rotate any KMS key material in HSM? Our provider supports automatic rotation but we want manual for now.
matt-psf: manual rotation agreed. I'll coordinate with cloud-ops for the HSM window.
secops-bot: Incident status: contained -> handoff. Next update expected by shift takeover.
anna-devsec: thanks team. Please do not close the ticket until postmortem + RBAC PRs are merged. Add any additional logs or evidence in the ticket. :thumbsup:
raj-oncall: acknowledged. Handoff message posted in INC-2026-1123. Good work.
maria-oncall: taking over. I will validate the deny is still in place and follow the rotation plan.
anna-devsec: final note for PM/ops: add an alert runbook section for KMS Decrypt spikes and a coupling check with deployments to reduce blast radius.
maria-oncall: noted. Will check runbook and update if missing steps.
